list.title: Open browser
list.description: Starts a browser window for the actions that follow: size, device and language.

list.title: Sign in
list.description: Opens a window where you sign in yourself, once. Opsis keeps the sign-in, encrypted, and the actions after this one use it.

list.title: Start recording
list.description: The video starts here. The actions before it run off camera, like signing in and the first page load.

list.title: Go to page
list.description: Opens a page address.

list.title: Click
list.description: Moves the cursor to an element and clicks it.

list.title: Type text
list.description: Types into a field, key by key.

list.title: Hover
list.description: Moves the cursor over an element without clicking, so a menu or tooltip can appear.

list.title: Drag
list.description: Drags an element onto another one, by a distance, or along a path, like moving a card or drawing a shape.

list.title: Scroll
list.description: Scrolls to an element or by a distance.

list.title: Choose option
list.description: Picks an option in a dropdown.

list.title: Upload file
list.description: Attaches a file from your project to a file field.

list.title: Press keys
list.description: Presses a key or shortcut, like Ctrl+K. Shows in keystroke chips.

list.title: Wait
list.description: Waits for an element, a quiet page, an address, or a fixed time. Waiting for something is more reliable than a fixed time.

list.title: Check text
list.description: Stops the recording early if some text is not on the page, so you don't export a broken take.

list.title: Find element early
list.description: Looks an element up ahead of time so a later action doesn't pause on screen while searching.

list.title: Run page script
list.description: Runs a small script in the page, e.g. to skip onboarding or turn on a feature. Put it before Go to page to run it as the site first opens.

list.title: Fake a response
list.description: Makes the site show fixed data for matching requests made after it, so every take looks the same. Put it before Go to page to cover the first load.

list.title: Freeze time
list.description: Pins the date and time the page sees, so clocks and "x minutes ago" never change between takes.

list.title: Hide clutter
list.description: Hides cookie banners, chat bubbles and anything else you list.

list.title: Chapter
list.description: Starts a new chapter. Can show a chapter card in the video.

list.title: HTML overlay
list.description: Shows your own HTML on top of the page while recording.

list.title: Open terminal
list.description: Starts a terminal for the actions that follow: its shell, folder and size.

list.title: Run command
list.description: Types a command, presses Enter and waits for it to finish.

list.title: Type
list.description: Types text into the terminal, one character at a time.

list.title: Press keys
list.description: Presses a key or a shortcut in the terminal.

list.title: Click
list.description: Clicks text or a cell, for programs that read the mouse.

list.title: Drag
list.description: Presses on one place, moves to another and lets go, for programs that read the mouse.

list.title: Mouse wheel
list.description: Turns the mouse wheel over text or a cell, for programs that read the mouse.

list.title: Wait for text
list.description: Waits until some text shows in the terminal.

list.title: Start recording
list.description: The film starts here. Actions before it set things up off camera.

list.title: Chapter
list.description: Starts a chapter of the film here, listed in exports.

list.title: Clear screen
list.description: Clears the terminal screen.

list.title: Record terminal take
list.description: Plays all connected terminal actions in one go and records the terminal.

list.title: Terminal look
list.description: The look of a terminal take: its colours, type size, spacing and cursor.

list.title: Cast file
list.description: Uses a terminal session recorded earlier and saved as a cast file as a take.

list.title: Play tape
list.description: Plays a tape file in a terminal and records it: what to type, the keys to press and the look of the terminal.

list.title: Export tape
list.description: Saves the connected terminal actions as a tape file, to play again or share.

list.title: Record take
list.description: Plays all connected browser actions in one go and records the screen.

list.title: Screenshot
list.description: Plays the connected actions, then takes a sharp screenshot of the page or one element. Frame image frames it; Use as clip shows it in the video.

list.title: Clip from take
list.description: Turns a take into a clip, shot the way its style says: the frame, the background and the camera moves. Browser takes play at 1.25×, terminal takes at their own speed; Speed changes it.

list.title: Camera
list.description: How the camera follows the take: zooming to each action or keeping the cursor in view, how close and how fast it moves.

list.title: Frame
list.description: How the take sits in the frame: a window with its title bar on a background, the whole page, or the screen of a laptop or phone.

list.title: Apply style
list.description: Gives every recording in a clip the same style, for takes joined in a Sequence or Layers.

list.title: Camera move
list.description: Moves the camera to a spot of your choice at a set time, from wherever it is or from another spot, and holds there.

list.title: Skip quiet parts
list.description: Speeds through moments where nothing happens.

list.title: Speed ramp
list.description: Speeds up or slows down chosen parts.

list.title: Crop
list.description: Cuts the recording down to an area.

list.title: Device frame
list.description: Puts the clip on a device's screen: a laptop or phone, a 3D screen, a pull back from a device, or a lineup of devices.

list.title: Motion blur
list.description: Adds blur to fast camera moves.

list.title: Cursor
list.description: Shows or hides the drawn cursor and sets its look, size and colours.

list.title: Click ripple
list.description: A ring that pulses on every click.

list.title: Keystroke chips
list.description: Shows keys and typed text as keycaps on screen.

list.title: Spotlight
list.description: Darkens everything except the element being used.

list.title: Highlight box
list.description: Draws a box around the element being used, cleanly or by hand.

list.title: Tooltip
list.description: A tooltip that stays attached to an element as the camera moves.

list.title: Callout arrow
list.description: A hand-drawn arrow pointing at an element, with a label.

list.title: Captions from script
list.description: Turns your script into timed captions at a natural speaking pace.

list.title: Show captions
list.description: Displays captions over the video, word by word, karaoke or line by line.

list.title: Redact take
list.description: Hides parts of the browser window, such as names, email addresses and keys, behind large pixels, a blur or a solid colour. The areas stay on the page while the camera moves.

list.title: Grade footage
list.description: Applies a colour grade to the footage in a clip: the page in each recording, and each video and image. The window and backdrop keep their colours; to grade the whole picture, use Apply grade on an exported file.

list.title: Colour and light
list.description: Changes brightness, contrast, colour, warmth and the colour of shadows and highlights. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Look file
list.description: Applies a colour look saved from another video editor. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Black and white and tint
list.description: Turns the picture black and white, sepia or one tint of colour. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Texture
list.description: Sharpens or softens the picture and adds dark edges and film grain. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Lens
list.description: Adds colour fringing, bends the picture like a lens and leaves trails behind motion. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Auto fix
list.description: Fixes a colour cast, stretches dull levels and smooths banding in skies. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Title card
list.description: A full-screen title with an optional eyebrow and subtitle.

list.title: Lower third
list.description: A name or caption bar in the lower part of the screen.

list.title: Redact
list.description: Hides parts of the screen with large pixels, a blur or a solid colour, to keep keys, emails and personal details out of the film.

list.title: Light leak
list.description: A warm light flare over the video.

list.title: Ink underline
list.description: A hand-dragged brush underline that sweeps itself across in a few stop-motion poses, thinning to a dry tail.

list.title: Scribble circle
list.description: A brush circle swept around a region of the frame, opening thin and closing thick, with grain breaking up the dry opening.

list.title: Keystroke
list.description: Shows a keyboard shortcut as keycaps being pressed.

list.title: Confetti
list.description: A burst of confetti to celebrate a moment.

list.title: Radial burst
list.description: Sculptural ribbons twist into a tilted ring and sweep outward through contour echoes for an expressive product introduction.

list.title: Polaroid
list.description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions.

list.title: TV power off
list.description: End a scene the way a tube does: the picture collapses into a glowing horizontal line, the line pinches to a phosphor dot, the dot decays, and the frame is left dead black.

list.title: Speed lines
list.description: Streaks shoot across the frame toward a point and die as they land, or radial focus lines rush in from the edges and snap onto one point for an impact frame. Lay it over a clip with Layers.

list.title: Terminal simulator
list.description: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.

list.title: Check list
list.description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out in full, then ticks and strikes through every done item, one at a time.

list.title: Search reveal
list.description: Expanding construction circles snap into a search pill, type editable text, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.

list.title: Agent run
list.description: An AI assistant working through a plan, ticking off each step.

list.title: Signup flow
list.description: A sign-up form that fills itself in, step by step.

list.title: AI prompt flow
list.description: An AI prompt composition: a prompt types into the field, the Generate button runs hover → press → loading, a skeleton shimmer reveals, then crossfades into the generated answer, and a ready toast slides in. A pure orchestrator — the shimmer is owned by the skeleton-block motion atom; every other channel comes from a composed primitive's hook.

list.title: Command menu
list.description: A command palette that opens, filters and picks an item.

list.title: Announce title
list.description: Launch title animation, product announcement intro with kinetic typography. A four-shot launch title: the eyebrow rushes past the camera on a receding type plane and lands on a colour field, the name assembles word by word on paper, and a macro pan across the tagline cuts wide as the line builds itself last word first while a white sweep drains it out of colour.

list.title: Punch lines
list.description: Kinetic typography title cards: bold statements that cut hard between beats. A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats.

list.title: Text highlight
list.description: Brings attention to one word in a sentence: a marker sweeps behind it, its colour changes, a line draws under it, it is struck out and replaced, or a shine passes over it.

list.title: Status cycle
list.description: Status badge animation: a pill whose label cycles through states. A centred line whose status pill cycles: the label rolls up behind a hard clip while the pill's width springs past its target and back, and the line re-centres around it.

list.title: Hero launch
list.description: Product launch hero scene for a SaaS launch video intro. Cinematic product-launch hero — two cards slide into formation as the headline reveals above.

list.title: Steps timeline
list.description: A row of steps that check off one after another along a line, each with its title and a short description.

list.title: Pricing card
list.description: A pricing plan card: the price rolls in, then each feature is ticked off.

list.title: Plan comparison table
list.description: A table comparing plans feature by feature, with one plan highlighted.

list.title: Changelog
list.description: A release note: version and date, then each change appears with its own tag.

list.title: End card
list.description: A closing card with a title, a button, your web address and social handles.

list.title: Kanban board
list.description: A task board where cards move from one column to the next.

list.title: File tree
list.description: A folder tree that opens one item at a time and highlights a file.

list.title: File upload
list.description: A pointer drags a file into an upload area, which catches it and uploads it.

list.title: Commit graph
list.description: A version history graph that draws its branches and merges commit by commit.

list.title: Notification stack
list.description: Notifications slide in, stack up and dismiss themselves.

list.title: Text mask
list.description: Big letters with a video, image or gradient showing through them.

list.title: Animated text
list.description: A line of text that comes in with the animation you pick.

list.title: Arrow
list.description: An arrow that draws itself to point at something, clean with a label or hand-drawn with a brush.

list.title: Background
list.description: A background to put behind other layers: a colour, a gradient, a texture or a moving pattern.

list.title: Logo set
list.description: A set of logos shown together: a grid that lights up, a field drifting past a headline, or a stack of chips.

list.title: Logo reveal
list.description: Brings in your logo and name: drawn as an outline, assembled from orbiting cards, or wiped in behind a spinning mark.

list.title: Code reveal
list.description: A code editor that writes out a file, then highlights the lines that matter.

list.title: Code diff
list.description: A code editor that changes one version of a file into another.

list.title: Chart
list.description: A chart that animates in from your numbers.

list.title: Metric cards
list.description: Key numbers that count up: several on cards with their trends, or one in a filling ring.

list.title: Rolling number
list.description: A value that rolls to its target: digits like an odometer, or a reel that rolls any characters.

list.title: Film look
list.description: Shows a clip as if seen through something: an old screen, a tape, a printed page or a camera lens.

list.title: 3D object
list.description: A logo, an image card, text or a model in 3D, turning under studio lights.

list.title: Transition
list.description: Brings a clip in with a transition wherever it is joined after another clip in a Sequence. Its Transition output sets the joins of a whole Sequence or Repeat.

list.title: Music
list.description: Background music under the video, with fades.

list.title: Sound effect
list.description: A sound from a file or made from settings, at a set time, on a browser action, or building up to end exactly on an action, a marker or the end of a clip.

list.title: Add sound
list.description: Puts sounds under a clip. Connect as many as you like. Sound stops where the clip ends.

list.title: Action sounds
list.description: A click sound at every click and a key sound at every keystroke of the takes in a clip, on one Mixer channel.

list.title: Room tone
list.description: A quiet bed of soft noise under the whole video, so cuts and silent stretches don't drop to dead silence.

list.title: Transition sounds
list.description: A whoosh at every transition in a clip, timed to its middle and fitted to its length, on one Mixer channel.

list.title: Sequence
list.description: Plays clips one after another. Each join uses the transition its clip comes in with, else the one on the Transition input, else a plain cut.

list.title: Layers
list.description: Stacks clips on top of each other: Layer 1 at the back, the last at the front.

list.title: Trim
list.description: Keeps only part of a clip.

list.title: Repeat
list.description: Plays a clip several times, with the transition on its Transition input at each seam.

list.title: Delay
list.description: Starts a clip later.

list.title: Chapter
list.description: Starts a chapter where a clip begins, for an export's chapters.

list.title: Speed
list.description: Plays a clip faster or slower.

list.title: Fit length
list.description: Makes a clip a set length, or as long as a sound, by speeding up, holding or cutting.

list.title: Choose by variable
list.description: Uses the first clip when a variable has a value, or the value you give, otherwise the second. Handy for A/B versions.

list.title: Media file
list.description: A video, image or sound from your project. Drop files on the canvas to add one.

list.title: Use as clip
list.description: Turns a file into a clip you can place in the video: an image, a video or an animation.

list.title: Trim file
list.description: Cuts a file down to a start and end. Makes a new file.

list.title: Join files
list.description: Joins files end to end. Fast when they match, otherwise converts them. Makes a new file.

list.title: Change speed
list.description: Speeds a file up or slows it down. Makes a new file.

list.title: Reverse
list.description: Plays a file backwards. Makes a new file.

list.title: Resize
list.description: Resizes a file, adding bars or cropping to fit. Makes a new file.

list.title: Convert
list.description: Saves a file in another format or quality. Makes a new file.

list.title: Apply grade
list.description: Applies a colour grade to a whole video or image file: everything in the picture, window and backdrop included. Makes a new file.

list.title: Make GIF
list.description: Turns a video into a GIF with clean colours. Makes a new file.

list.title: Extract sound
list.description: Saves the sound of a video as its own file. Makes a new file.

list.title: Even out volume
list.description: Makes the sound as loud as most online videos. Makes a new file.

list.title: Fix clicks
list.description: Removes clicks and pops from a recording. Makes a new file.

list.title: Fix clipping
list.description: Rebuilds peaks that were cut off when the sound was recorded too loud. Makes a new file.

list.title: Remove hum
list.description: Removes mains hum and its harmonics from a recording. Makes a new file.

list.title: Sound picture
list.description: Draws a sound's waveform or spectrum as an image.

list.title: Remove noise
list.description: Takes background noise and low rumble out of a voice recording. Makes a new file.

list.title: Soften “s” sounds
list.description: Softens harsh “s” sounds in a voice recording. Makes a new file.

list.title: Change pitch
list.description: Raises or lowers a sound's pitch in semitones while its length stays, to fit a song's key or make a playful voice. Makes a new file.

list.title: Voice effects
list.description: Makes a voice or a sound sound like a telephone, a radio, a small room, a hall or an echo. Makes a new file.

list.title: Fit music to the film
list.description: Makes a song end with the film: stretched a little, or looped with a crossfade, then faded. Makes a new file.

list.title: Shorten pauses
list.description: Shortens long silences in a voice recording without cutting words. Use it on a voice before placing it against a take. Makes a new file.

list.title: Grab frame
list.description: Saves one frame of a video as an image. Makes a new file.

list.title: Resize image
list.description: Makes an image a chosen width, height or both. Makes a new file.

list.title: Crop image
list.description: Keeps one part of an image: an area you draw on it, or what's inside margins. Makes a new file.

list.title: Rotate and flip
list.description: Turns an image in quarter turns, flips it, or straightens it by a small angle. Makes a new file.

list.title: Place image
list.description: Puts a second image, such as a logo or a watermark, on top of an image. Makes a new file.

list.title: Image format
list.description: Saves an image as PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF. Makes a new file.

list.title: Redact
list.description: Hides parts of an image, such as names, email addresses and keys, behind large pixels, a blur or a solid colour. Makes a new file.

list.title: Spotlight
list.description: Darkens or blurs everything outside the areas you draw, so the eye goes to them. Makes a new file.

list.title: Trim empty edges
list.description: Cuts away even-coloured margins, so the content sits tight. Makes a new file.

list.title: Make a colour transparent
list.description: Makes a flat background, such as a logo's white, see-through. Makes a new file.

list.title: Outline
list.description: Draws a coloured outline around the visible part of a see-through image, for cutouts and logos. Makes a new file.

list.title: Grid
list.description: Puts any number of images in a row, a column or a grid, with gaps and a background. Makes a new file.

list.title: Frame image
list.description: Frames an image for a post: plain with rounded corners and a soft shadow, in a window with its title bar, or on a laptop or phone, flat or tilted, on a padded background.

list.title: Before and after
list.description: Shows two pictures side by side, stacked, or split by a divider, with Before and After labels. Makes a new file.

list.title: Magnify
list.description: Shows one part of an image enlarged in a circle or a rounded box beside it, joined to the spot by a line, so small text reads. Makes a new file.

list.title: Compare screenshots
list.description: Boxes what changed between two captures of the same page, and makes a picture of only the differences. Makes a new file.

list.title: Annotate
list.description: Draws arrows, boxes, ovals, numbered steps and text on a picture, so a still explains itself. Makes a new file.

list.title: Export video
list.description: Renders the final video, one file per shape (16:9, 9:16…).

list.title: Export images
list.description: Saves a frame as images at social sizes: wide, link preview, square, portrait, story.

list.title: Save take
list.description: Saves a take's own recording as a file, as it was recorded: a video for a browser take, a cast file for a terminal take.

list.title: Note
list.description: A sticky note on the canvas. Not part of the video.

entries.title: Resize image
entries.description: Makes an image a chosen width, height or both. Makes a new file.

width.x-help: 0 follows the height and keeps the proportion.

height.x-help: 0 follows the width and keeps the proportion.

fit.x-help: When both sides are set: fit the whole image inside them, fill them and crop the rest, or stretch to exactly that size.

cropAtX.x-help: Click the picture to choose which part stays when it is filled and cropped.

shrinkOnly.x-help: A picture smaller than the size asked keeps its own size.

entries.title: Crop image
entries.description: Keeps one part of an image: an area you draw on it, or what's inside margins. Makes a new file.

area.x-help: Drag on the picture to choose the part to keep.

entries.title: Rotate and flip
entries.description: Turns an image in quarter turns, flips it, or straightens it by a small angle. Makes a new file.

angle.x-help: Tilts the picture by a small angle. The corners fill with the background colour.

cropCorners.x-help: Crops the straightened picture to the largest part with no empty corners.

background.x-help: Fills the corners a tilt opens up.

entries.title: Place image
entries.description: Puts a second image, such as a logo or a watermark, on top of an image. Makes a new file.

x.x-help: Click the picture to choose where the middle of the placed image goes.

size.x-help: The placed image's width, as a share of the picture's width.

entries.title: Image format
entries.description: Saves an image as PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF. Makes a new file.

quality.x-help: Higher looks better and makes a larger file.

speed.x-help: Higher saves faster and makes a larger file.

background.x-help: JPEG has no see-through parts, so they're filled with this colour.

entries.title: Redact
entries.description: Hides parts of an image, such as names, email addresses and keys, behind large pixels, a blur or a solid colour. Makes a new file.

areas.x-help: Drag on the picture to mark each part to hide.

entries.title: Spotlight
entries.description: Darkens or blurs everything outside the areas you draw, so the eye goes to them. Makes a new file.

areas.x-help: Drag on the picture to mark each part to keep bright.

entries.title: Trim empty edges
entries.description: Cuts away even-coloured margins, so the content sits tight. Makes a new file.

tolerance.x-help: How far a pixel's colour may be from the corner's and still count as empty edge.

edgeColor.x-help: The colour of the empty edge to cut.

entries.title: Make a colour transparent
entries.description: Makes a flat background, such as a logo's white, see-through. Makes a new file.

tolerance.x-help: How different a colour may be and still be made see-through.

edgesOnly.x-help: Keeps the same colour inside the picture, such as the white inside a logo.

entries.title: Outline
entries.description: Draws a coloured outline around the visible part of a see-through image, for cutouts and logos. Makes a new file.

entries.title: Grid
entries.description: Puts any number of images in a row, a column or a grid, with gaps and a background. Makes a new file.

fit.x-help: Same height and same width shrink every image to the smallest one's. Equal cells makes every cell as big as the largest image and centres each image in its own; nothing is enlarged.

align.x-help: Where a picture smaller than its cell sits.

entries.title: Frame image
entries.description: Frames an image for a post: plain with rounded corners and a soft shadow, in a window with its title bar, or on a laptop or phone, flat or tilted, on a padded background.

turn.x-help: Turns the picture away on its right side, or its left with a negative angle.

tilt.x-help: Leans the top back, or the bottom with a negative angle.

perspective.x-help: How far away the picture is seen from, in its long side. Closer looks more three-dimensional.

padding.x-help: Space around the picture, as a share of its shorter side.

shape.x-help: Grows the background around the picture to this shape; the picture is never cut.

align.x-help: Where the picture sits when the shape grows the background.

entries.title: Before and after
entries.description: Shows two pictures side by side, stacked, or split by a divider, with Before and After labels. Makes a new file.

layout.x-help: Split shows the before on one side of a divider and the after on the other, both at the before's size.

position.x-help: How far across the picture the divider sits.

labelRadius.x-help: Of the label's height; 50 makes a pill.

entries.title: Magnify
entries.description: Shows one part of an image enlarged in a circle or a rounded box beside it, joined to the spot by a line, so small text reads. Makes a new file.

x-labels.shown-and-zoom: Where it shows and a zoom

sizeFrom.x-help: Any two of the area, where it shows and the zoom decide the third. It never shrinks: a view drawn smaller than the area grows to fit it.

area.x-help: Drag on the picture over the part to enlarge. With Where it shows and a zoom, only its middle counts.

shown.x-help: Drag where the enlarged view goes. With The area and a zoom, only its middle counts.

line.x-help: Outlines the enlarged part and joins it to the view.

shadow.x-help: A soft shadow under the enlarged view.

entries.title: Compare screenshots
entries.description: Boxes what changed between two captures of the same page, and makes a picture of only the differences. Makes a new file.

sensitivity.x-help: Higher marks fainter changes. Lower it when compressed pictures show changes everywhere.

smallest.x-help: Changes smaller than this across are left unmarked.

padding.x-help: Space around each change. Changes whose boxes touch become one box.

differencesBackground.x-help: What the Differences picture shows where nothing changed.

entries.title: Annotate
entries.description: Draws arrows, boxes, ovals, numbered steps and text on a picture, so a still explains itself. Makes a new file.

fill.x-help: How strongly the colour fills the inside.

marks.x-help: Pick a kind and drag on the picture. Step numbers count up in the order they're listed.

entries.title: Export video
entries.description: Renders the final video, one file per shape (16:9, 9:16…).

chapters.x-help: Players list the film's chapters, taken from its Chapter actions.

chapterList.x-help: Also saves the chapter times as text, to paste into a video's description. It needs at least three chapters of ten seconds or more.

gl.x-help: The graphics card is about ten times faster. Use Software if exports fail.

firstChapter.x-help: Names the chapter added at the start when the first one comes later.

fullColour.x-help: Keeps every pixel's own colour instead of sharing it between neighbours. Sharper coloured text; fewer players open it.

gifPlays.x-help: How many times the GIF plays. 0 plays it forever.

gifEveryNth.x-help: Keeps one frame in this many, for a smaller GIF.

entries.title: Export images
entries.description: Saves a frame as images at social sizes: wide, link preview, square, portrait, story.

gl.x-help: The graphics card is about ten times faster. Use Software if exports fail.

entries.title: Save take
entries.description: Saves a take's own recording as a file, as it was recorded: a video for a browser take, a cast file for a terminal take.

entries.title: Group
entries.description: Boxes nodes together. Select nodes, then Group.

entries.title: Note
entries.description: A sticky note on the canvas. Not part of the video.
